description: Raw GLK vital tracker logs with reconstructed TCP hex frames for nighttime sleep periods

notes.raw_glk_tcp_frame: Reconstructed from parsed values per GLK protocol spec. Waveform data (100 bytes in 0x0E frames) is synthetic — real AD samples were not stored. Frame structure: 0x82 [len] [ack] [seq] [cmd] [data...] [xor_checksum]
notes.raw_api_body: Actual JSON body POSTed by the Pi to /api/health — this is what the backend received
